title: The latest signal
overview: Today’s index contains 240 recent records. The strongest signals span Consciousness / philosophy, Neuroscience, Quantum physics. Treat the ranking as a reading priority, not a verdict: preprints and ambitious theoretical claims still require independent scrutiny.

items.title: Immediate large-scale cortical network changes following acupuncture in patients with disorders of consciousness: a resting-state fNIRS study
items.why_it_matters: Introduction Disorders of consciousness (DOC) involve severe disruption of large-scale brain networks. This study investigated immediate cortical network changes following acupuncture in patients with DOC using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).

items.title: Emergent flow theory: autonomic coherence as a gain parameter for the temporal architecture of conscious integration
items.why_it_matters: Contemporary neuroscientific theories of consciousness—including Global Neuronal Workspace Theory (GNW), Integrated Information Theory (IIT), and the Predictive Processing/Free Energy Principle (PP/FEP)—have not formalized autonomic and neuromodulatory state as explicit dynamic control parameters within models of conscious integration. This gap constitutes the explanatory niche addressed by the Emergent Flow Theory (EFT).

items.title: Review of Quantum Machine Learning Integration in Modern Computing
items.why_it_matters: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is a new multidisciplinary field that exploits the computational power of quantum computing for machine learning problems.
